StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

ModifyMaxEnergy.rationale: amount + base.Amount with an owner guard on both sides (PyrePower.cs:16-23 vs powers.py:991-994), and the sim consumes it in the right place: player.py:163 runs modify_max_energy BEFORE should_reset_energy (:164) and uses the modified value on BOTH arms (:165 reset, :167 add-to-current), which is C#'s ResetEnergy/AddMaxEnergyToCurrent pair at CombatManager.cs:641-648. So Pyre works under a Barricade-style reset veto too. The power is never removed on either side, so it is a permanent +N max energy for the combat. Third-file citations, not hashed here.
